name: docs
description: A docs sweep: a finder per doc file checks what it says against the code, a skeptic verifies each finding, only the confirmed reach Claude

stages.prompt:
Read {item.file} and check each thing it says against the code: a command, flag, default, file, key or behaviour it names that the code no longer has or does differently. Report each as a finding, the doc's line and the code's, with no style or wording notes.

{context}

Check this finding about a doc against the code at {base}:

{item}
